part.text:
Fixed. The root cause was in `streamTrim` (src/t_stream.c:811-813): the entry ID deltas were read into 32-bit `int` variables, but deltas like `id.ms - master_id.ms` can exceed `INT32_MAX` when the master entry has a small ID (e.g. `10-1`) and later entries use auto-generated millisecond timestamps. The truncated (negative) values made every entry appear below the MINID threshold, so all entries were deleted.

The fix changes `ms_delta`/`seq_delta` to `int64_t`, matching `lpGetInteger`'s return type (used correctly everywhere else, e.g. `lpGetEdgeStreamID`).

Verified:
- Reproduction from the issue: `XTRIM MINID` now deletes only entries below the threshold (XLEN 4 instead of 0).
- `./runtest --single unit/type/stream` passes fully.
